PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-003.text: Users must not be able to UPDATE their own role field via RLS-permitted self-update.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-003.assertion: forall u: update_user(u, fields) => 'role' NOT IN fields OR is_admin(u) == true

locations.note: profileUpdateSchema (L18-20) only allows student_number; is_admin field is absent. update uses createAdminClient() but only updates { student_number } (L401-404)
is_admin can only be toggled by an admin (checkAdmin guard at L503-506); self-toggle blocked at L508-510
